data.description:
## What
Create fixture-based test harness for the stateful re-review pipeline.

## Fixtures to create
`tests/fixtures/review-convergence/` directory:
- `pr-65.diff` — diff for PR #65 with prior-cycle findings JSON
- `pr-65-prior-findings.json` — prior cycle findings for PR #65
- `pr-62.diff` — diff for PR #62 with prior-cycle findings JSON
- `pr-62-prior-findings.json` — prior cycle findings for PR #62
- 5 SHA-pinned single-cycle fixtures: `single-<sha>.diff` + `single-<sha>-prior-findings.json` for 5 recent PRs

## Test harness: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_pipeline_fixtures.py
4 behavioral assertions verified against the fixture diffs:
1. RESUSTAIN_OF + proximity overlap → exactly one arbiter dispatch for same finding ID
2. NEW_INTRODUCED on overlapping/proximate lines without escape_rationale → rejected, re-dispatched
3. NEW_PRE_EXISTING (not in scope for this epic — skip or assert auto-downgrade if present)
4. DOWNGRADE_TO without valid named_rebuttal → reclassified as ACCEPT_DEFENSE

## Fixture generation
Use `gh pr diff <pr-number>` to fetch diffs; save them to the fixture files.
Use placeholder `prior-findings.json` files with representative finding schemas for initial testing.

## Single-cycle regression fixtures
5 recent PRs (from last 90 days, no prior-cycle context):
- These use DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE=1 (no two-call path)
- Assert: findings structure equivalent to pre-epic behavior modulo new relation fields

## Files to Create
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-65.diff (fetch from gh pr diff)
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-65-prior-findings.json
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-62.diff
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-62-prior-findings.json
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/single-*.diff (x5)
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/single-*-prior-findings.json (x5)
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_pipeline_fixtures.py

## Note
This task uses mock LLM responses (not real API calls) — fixtures test pipeline structure and orchestration logic, not LLM quality.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test -d tests/fixtures/review-convergence
- test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_pipeline_fixtures.py
- pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_pipeline_fixtures.py exits 0 with mock LLM responses
- 4 test functions named to match the 4 behavioral assertions

## Testing Mode
GREEN — new test infrastructure

## File Impact
- tests/fixtures/review-convergence/ (new directory + files)
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_pipeline_fixtures.py (create)
data.title: GREEN: tests/fixtures/review-convergence/ — PR#65, PR#62, 5 SHA-pinned fixtures + behavioral test harness
